name: GhostChat – 3KB Lightweight Live Chat
author: jorbach

sections.description:
Stop killing your SEO with bloated chat widgets.

GhostChat (by The Chat Widget) is the world’s lightest live chat solution. While other widgets add 200KB+ to your site and tank your Lighthouse scores, GhostChat is only 3KB gzipped.

Why GhostChat?

  • Extreme Performance: 30x smaller than Intercom or Zendesk. Won’t slow down your site.
  • Privacy First: No cookies. No tracking. GDPR compliant by design.
  • Gmail Threading: Reply to your customers directly from your Gmail inbox. No new dashboard to learn.
  • CRM Lite: Built-in contact management. Email required before messaging (automatic lead capture).
  • Zero Bloat: One script tag. No dependencies. No jQuery.
  • Smart Setup: Paste the full script tag or just the ID—we figure it out instantly.

Speed Comparison

  • Intercom/Drift: 150KB – 300KB
  • Typical React Widgets: 50KB – 100KB
  • GhostChat: 3KB (Lightning Fast)

Key Features

  • Gmail Threading: Reply from your inbox. Threads stay in sync.
  • CRM Lite: Export contacts to CSV, add notes, view history.
  • Automation: Business hours, away mode, offline email capture.
  • Mobile PWA: Reply from your phone like WhatsApp.
  • Edge-powered: 10-30ms latency worldwide.
sections.installation:
1. Install GhostChat via the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings > GhostChat.
  4. Enter your Site ID from app.thechatwidget.com.
    • Pro Tip: You can paste the entire script tag from your dashboard, and we’ll automatically extract the ID for you!
sections.faq:
Do I need an account?

Yes, sign up free at thechatwidget.com/signup to get a Site ID.

Is it really free?

Yes! We offer a 30-day free trial with all features. No credit card required. After that, plans start at just $5/month (or $50/year for 2 months free).

Does it slow down my site?

No! At 3KB, GhostChat is 20-40x smaller than competitors like Intercom (120KB+), Zendesk (150KB+), or Drift (200KB+). It has zero impact on page speed or Lighthouse scores.

Does it track visitors?

No. GhostChat uses zero tracking and zero cookies. However, visitors must provide their email before messaging (this captures leads automatically). No cookie banners needed.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes. GhostChat doesn’t track or store personal data without consent. Perfect for EU businesses.

Can I customize the widget?

Yes! Customize colors, position, and welcome messages in your dashboard.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes! The dashboard is a mobile-first PWA. Install it on your phone and reply to customers like WhatsApp.

Can I reply from Gmail?

Yes! This is one of our key features. When a visitor sends a message, you get an email notification. Reply directly from Gmail — your response appears in the chat widget, and the conversation threads perfectly. Visitors can also reply via email.

What is CRM Lite?

CRM Lite is our built-in contact management system. Every visitor who messages you becomes a contact (email is required before messaging). View all contacts, see conversation history, add notes, and export to CSV. Available on Growth and Business plans.

Does it support automation?

Yes! Set your business hours, toggle away mode, and automatically capture visitor emails when you’re offline. Available on Growth and Business plans.
